# sfcompute_sku (Data Source)

Reads sku from SF Compute (`GET /v2/skus/{id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sfcompute_sku" "h100" {
  id = "sku_4UpxzQw7A8N"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) SKU ID

### Read-Only

- `accelerator` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accelerator))
- `alias` (String) A short, unique among live, human-recognizable name for this SKU, e.g. `richmond`. For display only - reference the SKU by `id`.
- `availability_zone` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--availability_zone))
- `deleted_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `form_factor` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--form_factor))
- `infiniband_fabric` (String) InfiniBand fabric this SKU's instances attach to. An instance can join an InfiniBand partition only if the partition is on this fabric, so pass it as `fabric` when creating one. Absent when the SKU has no InfiniBand fabric.
- `local_storage_bytes` (Attributes) Total local storage in bytes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--local_storage_bytes))
- `memory_bytes` (Attributes) Total system memory in bytes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--memory_bytes))
- `num_accelerators` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--num_accelerators))
- `num_vcpus` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--num_vcpus))
- `rdma_type` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rdma_type))
- `region` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--region))
- `supports_public_ipv4` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--supports_public_ipv4))

<a id="nestedatt--accelerator"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accelerator`

Read-Only:

- `display_value` (String)
- `value` (String) The AI accelerator chip model, e.g. `h100`.

Read-Only:

- `display_value` (String)
- `value` (String) An independent failure domain within a region, e.g. `a`.

Read-Only:

Read-Only:

- `display_value` (String)
- `value` (Number) The total local storage available to the VM, in bytes.

### Nested Schema for `memory_bytes`

Read-Only:

- `display_value` (String)
- `value` (Number) The total system memory per node, in bytes.

### Nested Schema for `num_accelerators`

Read-Only:

Read-Only:

### Nested Schema for `rdma_type`
